    SELECT [t0].[PaymentOptionId], [t0].[CategoryId], [t0].[PaymentMethodId], [t1].[Id], [t1].[Name]
    FROM [AuctionM_dbuser].[TblAssetCategoryPaymentMethod] AS [t0]
    INNER JOIN [AuctionM_dbuser].[TblAssetPaymentMethod] AS [t1] ON [t0].[PaymentMethodId] = [t1].[Id]
) AS [s] ON [t].[CategoryId] = [s].[CategoryId]
WHERE [t].[IsDeleted] = CAST(0 AS bit)
ORDER BY [t].[CategoryId], [s].[PaymentOptionId]
